title: Property Finance Introducers UK
summary: Introducer / referral-partner page of Silver Oak Capital (London commercial mortgage broker). Intermediaries can refer borrowers for commercial mortgages, buy-to-let mortgages, bridging loans, development finance, marine finance or aviation finance. The firm positions itself as structuring bespoke debt solutions across the UK and Western Europe (residential and commercial mortgages, bridging, development finance, complex structures, special situations). Introducers are paid 'a competitive percentage of our procurement fee upon the successful completion of the loan', with terms agreed upfront; the actual percentage is not published. Process: Silver Oak issues indicative terms; once the client agrees to proceed, the introducer puts Silver Oak in direct contact with the borrower so it can run the formal application; the introducer keeps receiving milestone updates (valuation, legals, completion) and is paid as agreed on completion. The page stresses discretion, transparency and strict non-circumvention. Contact block: enquiry@silveroakcapital.co.uk, +44 207 459 4440, 91 Wimpole Street, London W1G 0EE. H1 and meta description were not revealed by the search results.
